Matt H.: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of requests to /api/v1/search carrying ad-hoc query params (utm_*, session_id, ab_test) that we never need in backend services. It’s causing cache churn and weird downstream keys. Can we implement a per-route query whitelist + strip everything else? Also need to scrub Set-Cookie attributes from proxied responses on public routes.

Leila R.: Agree. We already strip some headers but query param scrubbing is new. Two concerns: 1) preserve signed/presigned query params (we can't strip signatures), 2) don’t obliterate legitimate analytics/query flags for product metrics.

Jin (eng-platform): Thought: route-level config like `query_whitelist: ['q','page','filters']` + `strip_unknown_query: true`. Add `preserve_patterns` for regex keys to keep (eg `^sig_`, `^x_`). Also need cache-key normalization so stripping actually collapses cache entries. Draft config below: 

```yaml
route:
  path: /api/v1/search
  query_whitelist:
    - q
    - page
    - filters
  preserve_patterns:
    - '^sig_'
  strip_unknown_query: true
response_rewrite:
  remove_response_headers:
    - Set-Cookie
  response_cookie_scrub:
    keep: []
    remove_attributes:
      - Domain
      - Path
      - Secure?
```

Matt H.: Nice shape. Couple asks: 1) telemetry — log what we strip (key names only, no PII) at an info/sample level for first 24h so teams can opt their params in if needed. 2) Migration: make rule opt-in per route by default, then flip on for high-traffic routes after canary.

Jin (eng-platform): Yep — add `telemetry.sample_rate: 0.01` and `telemetry.event: rewrite.query.strip`. For migration, add `enable_strict_query_normalization: false` default and a rollout flag. Also will update cache-key logic to remove `strip_unknown_query` params from the key generation module.

Leila R.: CDN/cache note — if we strip params but CDN still keys on raw URL, it won’t help. We need router to emit `cache_key: normalized_url` for our edge cache layer. Also product sometimes uses `ab_test` query to drive experiences; teams need per-route allowlist for that. I can add per-team allow entries in the Console.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary deploy of rewrite-rules-v2 to us-west-2 (3 hosts)

Matt H.: Plan: canary on 0.5% traffic first, enable telemetry sampling 1% during canary, watch cache hit ratio and 500s. Jin — please add e2e tests:
- presigned URLs preserved
- analytics params removed but logged
- cache key normalized when strip_unknown_query=true

Leila R.: :thumbsup: I’ll own the Console UX: add "Query Rules" panel under Route config, show stripped param histogram, and toggle for response cookie scrubbing. Default will be conservative (only keep q,page,filters).

Jin (eng-platform): Opening PR with schema + unit tests and e2e harness tests. Will include feature flag `enable_strict_query_normalization` and telemetry knobs. ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial PR.

Matt H.: Great — once PR is up we’ll coordinate canary window with SRE and have docs + rollback steps in the PR description. Thanks all.
